label: EXISTING_CONCRETE_INDIVIDUAL_3: ConcreteAt ex concrete x w means ex x w and concrete x w
definition: ConcreteAt ex concrete x w means ex x w and concrete x w. Existence and a theory-relative concreteness criterion are independent supplied predicates. No causal-powers, spatiotemporal or independence/actuality account is endorsed. Absence of concrete individuals is an empty extension at an existing world, not an empty world type. Abstract-object status is not inferred from failing this predicate.
note: Theory-relative diagnostic for #435; source-grounded adoption and concreteness defenses remain open. See docs/necessary-individual-quantifiers.md. #1103: the concreteness argument here is world-indexed (ExistsAt W I), a different, world-varying sense from the world-independent shared classification. Its Lean name is kept because frozen Challenges use it. The adopted sense is the special case concrete x w := HasEsseInRe InAct esse x, constant across worlds (DISAMB-CONCRETE-ABSTRACT-CRITERIA).
